articles.title: Nvidia employee warns of 'irreplaceable' talent exodus if Jensen Huang not reinstated — cautions board and top brass that 'talent at Nvidia is now contemplating departing'
articles.text:
Nvidia employee warns of 'irreplaceable' talent exodus if Jensen Huang not reinstated — cautions board and top brass that 'talent at Nvidia is now contemplating departing'
Nvidia is stuck between a rock and a hard place, as "irreplaceable talent" wants to leave if Jensen Huang isn't reinstated as CEO amidst the spy affair controversy.
Following the resignation of former CEO Jensen Huang, there are warnings that important Nvidia employees are planning to leave if the company doesn’t reinstate him. According to the Wall Street Journal, an employee sent an internal letter to the top executives and board of directors stating that “failure to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive could lead to the loss of ‘irreplaceable talent.’” Huang resigned last week amidst a firestorm of reports about an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, a further affair with VP of health care Kimberly Powell, and allegations the former relationship may have facilitated chip smuggling into China.
According to WSJ’s sources, director of developer technology Nader Khalil wrote the letter, urging that Huang be reinstated as CEO, lest the company lose loyal and important employees. The letter’s recipients, according to WSJ, comprised roughly 60 direct reports and the 10 members of the board, and Khalil warned that “Irreplaceable talent at Nvidia is now contemplating departing.”
The internal letter, along with the standwithjensen.com open letter to reinstate him, shows how important Huang is to the employees of Nvidia. Without the key long-term employees, which the company heavily depends on, progress could halt, or possibly regress, as Nvidia would lose the employees who have worked on and built the architectures and systems that make Nvidia what it is, along with their leader, Huang — who has recently stated that he would be honored to come back as CEO.
The open letter, signed by multiple Nvidia current and former employees, and tech CEOs and investors, states that employees are concerned that Huang was ousted unfairly and without due process, expressing that the employees do not have “access to the board’s private deliberations,” and that they have not been shown evidence that Alice Huang was indeed a spy, which even US intelligence doesn’t have solid evidence of. The open letter demands that Huang be reinstated as CEO while ensuring an independent investigation and a fair hearing, including providing a “specific, evidence-based explanation” of why Nvidia shouldn’t keep Huang as CEO — with Huang scheduled to appear before a House of Foreign Affairs panel concerning his affairs with the alleged spy.
Despite the letter, the support of other Silicon Valley CEOs, and even President Trump, Nvidia is still not considering bringing Huang back as CEO. Nvidia is the hottest AI hardware company at the moment, and its employees are highly desirable not only within the US, but possibly China as well. China surely wouldn’t mind getting its hands on a few key employees, who, if they choose to leave, are likely not going to have a hard time finding another job.

articles.title: Infoblox confirms company and customer data exposed in SharePoint breach
articles.text:
Infoblox confirms company and customer data exposed in SharePoint breach
Infoblox says its investigation is ongoing
- Infoblox is investigating a supply-chain breach in which attackers allegedly used a vendor’s access to steal employee and customer data
- Exposed information reportedly includes employee personal details and customer network configuration backups
- Company is offering identity protection services and warning affected individuals about phishing and fraud risks
Infoblox has said it is currently investigating reports of a cyberattack and sensitive data theft.
Initial reports describe it as a third-party supply chain attack in which employee data and customer network information were exfiltrated.
The Register revealed how Infoblox worked with a third-party data migration vendor which was granted trusted access to its SharePoint system, meaning the unidentified attackers apparently obtained login credentials for vendor accounts, used them to access Infoblox’s Microsoft SharePoint instances, and pulled data straight from there.
NIOS deployments and personal data
Exactly who the attackers are, or how they obtained the credentials, was not explained. Usually, they either steal the passwords with infostealers, or trick victims into handing over the credentials themselves.
The former method is easy in theory - get the victim to download malware and the program sends over stored passwords, authentication cookies, sensitive documents, and other files. The latter is somewhat more difficult since it involves creating a fake login page of a known - and used - online service that secretly relays all submitted information, sending it to the victim, and hoping they try to log in.
This is usually done through phishing emails that warn the victim they will lose access to accounts, or that the affiliated data will be deleted, making them hurry and not pay attention to what they’re doing.
Among the nabbed information are some customers’ Network Identity Operating System (NIOS) deployments, The Register claims. “These are saved snapshots of customers’ network data, such as DNS, DHCP configurations, Grid databases, and reporting logs, that can be used to fully recover the appliance or grid in case of a system failure or faulty upgrade.”
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
There’s plenty of value in stolen NIOS config backups. These can serve as blueprints of a corporate network, including DNS infrastructure, DHCP settings, internal IP address range, and connected systems.
This kind of information can be useful to map a network, identify critical infrastructure, locate potential weak points, and plan targeted attacks. DNS configurations, for example, can reveal internal hostnames or domain structures, helping crooks identify valuable targets or craft custom-tailored and highly convincing phishing lures. Access to Grid databases and recovery snapshots could also expose sensitive operational details that make it easier to impersonate legitimate infrastructure or disrupt network services.
The attackers also apparently stole employee data. Citing an email Infoblox CEO Scott Harrell allegedly sent to employees, The Register says the attackers took financial information such as direct deposit details, contact info, dates of birth, and Social Security numbers for employees and dependents.
Offering help
This is more than enough information to launch phishing attacks which could very easily turn into ransomware or wire fraud.
When asked for comment, the company told The Register that it was “investigating a security event involving unauthorized access to certain company information through a compromised third-party data migration vendor.” No names or concrete figures anywhere in the statement.
“We have sent notifications about this security event and are providing support and guidance as appropriate,” the Infoblox spokesperson said. “Based on our investigation to date, we have no indication that any Infoblox products, cloud services, software updates or build-and-release processes were involved. Our priority is to fully investigate and resolve this issue."
The company is now offering money to the victims - $100 of “spot bonus” to help individuals purchase password management services, as well as two years of free identity theft and credit monitoring services - these days a standard practice in similar incidents. Infoblox also urged everyone to be "especially alert” for phishing, vishing, fraud, or other suspicious communications.

articles.title: Jensen Huang: "I Would Be Honored to Return as CEO"
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Jensen Huang: "I Would Be Honored to Return as CEO"
Jensen Huang took to X today to declare that he is willing to return as NVIDIA CEO if the company's board wants him back. In his statement, the former NVIDIA CEO thanked all his supporters and claimed that many employees, investors, business partners, and customers had reached out to him, asking him to come back. That part of the statement also seems like an indirect acknowledgment of the various online movements that have sprung up in his favor since he stepped down. This is also Jensen Huang's first public statement since he resigned from all his roles at NVIDIA on November 12, following the start of an investigation by the NVIDIA board of directors into Huang's extramarital affairs.
Perhaps most importantly, Jensen Huang opened the door to his return as NVIDIA CEO, at least from his side. This is important after reports recently emerged that Huang had discussed the possibility of a comeback with his close confidants, and the "Stand with Jensen" open letter continues to gain momentum online. Other than that, Huang also admitted that he "did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA" and acknowledged the mistakes he made in his personal life. Jensen says he is cooperating with the board's investigation, and if the board judges that his return would be in the best interest of "our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America," then he would be honored to return to his former position as CEO.The board, however, might see things a little differently. According to CNBC, a person familiar with the matter told them that the board is not considering bringing Huang back and remains focused on the investigation. That was on Monday, but things have been moving fast in this whole situation from the beginning. Moreover, we cannot gloss over the report that NVIDIA, under Huang, allegedly funded AI startups to buy its GPUs to keep demand high. It should also be remembered that Interim CEO Colette Kress reportedly opposed Huang's stance in that situation. NVIDIA reports its third-quarter results on Tuesday, November 17, so it's reasonable to expect questions about the leadership situation on the earnings call.
Jensen Huang's full X post is as follows:
Jensen Huang on XOver the past week, I've been overwhelmed by the love and support of friends, industry colleagues, and people I've never met. Thank you to everyone who has shown kindness to my family and me. It means the world to me.
I came to the United States 53 years ago, and becoming an American citizen is one of the greatest gifts and proudest moments of my life. NVIDIA has been my life's work. Building it into the company it is today alongside my colleagues has been a privilege and an honor. Nowhere but in America could a company like NVIDIA be possible. I love our country, and I love NVIDIA.
I did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life. I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret. I own my mistakes completely, and I am committed to cooperating with the Board's independent investigation. 
Since my departure, I've seen an outpouring of calls from NVIDIA's employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO. Many continue to reach out to me directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics. NVIDIA is a once-in-a-generation company. If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.
Thank you again to everyone who has shared their good wishes. I am profoundly humbled by your support. To my family: I love you, and I will spend the rest of my life being worthy of yours.
Jensen

articles.title: Hacker que vazou GTA 6 usou Fire TV Stick para invadir a Rockstar • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Hacker que vazou GTA 6 usou Fire TV Stick para invadir a Rockstar
Integrante do grupo Lapsus$ confessou ataque de 2022 à Rockstar Games. Sentença será definida em 23 de novembro.
Quatro anos depois, o hacker responsável pelo vazamento de 90 vídeos de Grand Theft Auto 6 em 2022 se declarou culpado pela invasão à Rockstar Games. Arion Kurtaj, de 21 anos, admitiu os crimes perante a Justiça britânica nessa segunda-feira (16/11). Na época, o ataque expôs imagens do jogo ainda em desenvolvimento.
Segundo o Ministério Público britânico (CPS), Kurtaj também confessou invasões aos sistemas da Uber, Revolut e da operadora de telecomunicações BT/EE. O jovem integrava o grupo hacker Lapsus$ e utilizou um dispositivo Amazon Fire TV Stick para realizar parte dos ataques enquanto estava hospedado em um hotel.
O caso ganhou repercussão quando dezenas de gravações de GTA 6 foram publicadas na internet. O Tecnoblog noticiou o vazamento e a tentativa de extorsão à Rockstar, que mais tarde confirmou o acesso não autorizado aos seus sistemas. Em 2026, a empresa voltou a enfrentar um vazamento, mas o responsável ainda não foi identificado.
Kurtaj estava em liberdade sob fiança quando foi transferido para um hotel em setembro de 2022 por razões de segurança. Mesmo após ter equipamentos apreendidos, ele continuou realizando ataques com um celular, a conexão Wi-Fi da televisão do quarto e um Fire TV Stick da Amazon.
O esquema permitiu que Kurtaj continuasse acessando sistemas de empresas, apesar das restrições impostas pela Justiça. Entre os alvos estava a Rockstar Games. Sob o pseudônimo TeaPotUberHacker, o invasor publicou as gravações em um fórum dedicado à franquia. Ele também ameaçou divulgar o código-fonte do jogo caso a desenvolvedora não entrasse em contato.
A invasão foi um dos episódios de maior repercussão associados ao Lapsus$, grupo que também ganhou notoriedade no Brasil. Em 2022, a Polícia Federal também prendeu um suspeito de integrar a organização, investigada por ataques que afetaram o ConecteSUS e outras plataformas.
A situação judicial de Kurtaj passou por mudanças desde o vazamento. Em 2023, ele foi considerado incapaz de participar de um julgamento criminal convencional por questões de saúde.
Na época, a Justiça determinou sua internação por tempo indeterminado em um hospital de custódia. Posteriormente, uma nova avaliação médica considerou Kurtaj apto a responder ao processo. Ele foi transferido para uma prisão em janeiro de 2026, abrindo caminho para o julgamento.
A sentença será definida em 23 de novembro, no Tribunal da Coroa de Woolwich, em Londres, quatro dias depois do lançamento oficial de GTA VI.

articles.title: Jensen Huang se ofrece a volver como director ejecutivo de Nvidia tras su salida por presunto espionaje
articles.text:
Jensen Huang aseguró que estaría dispuesto a retomar el cargo de director ejecutivo de Nvidia, aunque la junta directiva del fabricante de chips de inteligencia artificial (IA) habría descartado, por ahora, la posibilidad de restituir a su fundador tras su salida en medio de un presunto caso de espionaje.
En sus primeras declaraciones públicas desde su dimisión del jueves pasado, Huang afirmó que consideraría un honor volver a liderar la compañía, valorada en 3,7 billones de dólares.
“Si el consejo considera que mi regreso beneficia a los accionistas, a los empleados, a la empresa y a Estados Unidos, me sentiría honrado de atender esa petición y volver a ejercer como director ejecutivo”, señaló Huang, según Financial Times.
La salida de Huang se produjo después de que surgieran acusaciones sobre una supuesta relación con una mujer que, de acuerdo con las autoridades estadounidenses, tendría vínculos con los servicios de inteligencia chinos y ocuparía además un puesto ejecutivo de alto rango en Nvidia.
Durante el fin de semana ganó fuerza una campaña para promover su regreso. Huang, quien habría estado al frente de Nvidia durante 33 años desde su fundación, incluso recibió el respaldo condicionado del presidente Donald Trump, que el lunes dijo estar abierto a su vuelta.
Sin embargo, la junta —que analiza perfiles internos y externos para cubrir el puesto— habría transmitido ese mismo día que no contempla reincorporar a Huang.
Qué investigó la junta directiva de Nvidia
La junta de Nvidia abrió una investigación independiente para determinar si Jensen Huang pudo haber sido blanco de una operación de inteligencia extranjera. La revisión quedó a cargo de un comité de directores independientes, con asesoramiento legal externo, después de que informaciones periodísticas vincularan al ejecutivo con una empresaria china investigada por autoridades estadounidenses.
La empresa afirmó entonces que no tenía razones para creer que la seguridad nacional de Estados Unidos o secretos corporativos hubieran resultado comprometidos. La pesquisa, sin embargo, puso bajo escrutinio la conducta del entonces director ejecutivo y los mecanismos de gobierno corporativo de una compañía decisiva para el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial.
Por qué el caso trascendió el ámbito personal de Jensen Huang
La controversia adquirió una dimensión política por las sospechas sobre posibles transferencias de chips avanzados a compañías chinas. La empresaria relacionada con el caso había trabajado para Megaspeed, una firma de computación en la nube de Singapur que estaba bajo investigación por un eventual acceso de China a procesadores de Nvidia sujetos a controles de exportación de Estados Unidos.
Las acusaciones no fueron verificadas de manera independiente por medios estadounidenses, y China negó cualquier implicación en una operación de espionaje. Aun así, legisladores estadounidenses solicitaron explicaciones y plantearon la necesidad de endurecer las restricciones sobre las ventas de chips de inteligencia artificial al gigante asiático.
Qué obstáculos enfrenta un eventual regreso de Huang a Nvidia
La dimisión de Huang no se produjo solo en medio de la investigación sobre sus vínculos personales. También surgieron reportes sobre una segunda relación extramatrimonial con una ejecutiva de Nvidia que, según The New York Times, le reportaba de forma directa.
Trump afirmó el domingo 8 de noviembre de 2026 que Jensen Huang había “hecho un trabajo increíble para nuestro país” y que el entonces jefe de Nvidia le dijo que desconocía que la empresaria china con la que mantuvo una relación fuera una espía.
La sucesión abrió un debate sobre la continuidad del liderazgo en Nvidia, donde Huang ejerció durante más de tres décadas y mantiene una participación accionaria relevante. La directora financiera, Colette Kress, asumió como directora ejecutiva interina mientras la empresa inició la búsqueda de un reemplazo permanente entre candidatos internos y externos.

articles.title: Xiaomi voit triple pour vos lessives et muscle son offensive dans l’électroménager en France
articles.text:
Xiaomi annonce un lave-linge séchant à trois tambours, des réfrigérateurs de 546 litres et deux nouveaux aspirateurs pour le marché français. Les appareils de nettoyage sont annoncés disponibles, tandis que le gros électroménager arrivera entre fin décembre et janvier.
Xiaomi veut désormais occuper une bonne partie de la buanderie et de la cuisine. La marque détaille une nouvelle vague d’appareils Mijia pour la France, avec un produit qui sort franchement du lot : un lave-linge séchant réunissant trois tambours indépendants. Autour de cette machine, le constructeur aligne aussi des réfrigérateurs et des aspirateurs, en faisant de Xiaomi Home le point de commande commun.
Trois tambours pour éviter d’enchaîner les petites lessives
Le Mijia Lave-linge séchant Hublot Pro 12 kg, que nous avions déjà pu voir à l’IFA 2026 de Berlin en septembre dernier, réunit un tambour principal et deux plus petits. L’idée est de traiter séparément différentes catégories de linge, sans attendre de terminer un premier cycle pour lancer le suivant. Les petits tambours proposent aussi un séchage à basse température pour les textiles délicats.
Xiaomi avance des économies d’eau, d’électricité et de temps grâce au fonctionnement simultané. La comparaison mérite toutefois d’être précisée : ses chiffres opposent l’utilisation des trois tambours à trois cycles successifs sur son modèle de 10 kg. Ils ne signifient pas que chaque lessive consommera automatiquement deux fois moins.
La machine ajuste la durée et la température du séchage, et permet de lancer ou personnaliser les programmes dans Xiaomi Home. Le programme rapide de 12 minutes concerne de petites charges : les conditions de test indiquent notamment 1 à 2 kg dans le tambour principal.
Son lancement français est prévu courant janvier 2027, mais son prix pourra faire refroidir avec un tarif annoncé de 1 499,99 €. Xiaomi vise clairement à concurrencer le marché haut de gamme, reste à voir si les utilisateurs seront sensibles à ces innovations.
Un robot qui lève les pieds et un balai qui vide son bac
Du côté du nettoyage de la maison, Xiaomi a également quelques nouveautés avec le Robot Vacuum 6 Max. Ce modèle combine un rouleau lavant, une serpillière dédiée aux zones difficiles et une brosse latérale extensible. Deux pieds articulés doivent lui permettre de franchir des seuils isolés atteignant 6 cm, selon les essais du constructeur. Son LiDAR rétractable autoriserait le passage sous les meubles laissant au moins 9,3 cm.
Xiaomi annonce également 35 000 Pa d’aspiration et une reconnaissance des obstacles et des taches par caméras. Ces caractéristiques ne préjugent pas de son efficacité réelle, qu’un test devra établir. La station lave les éléments de nettoyage à l’eau chaude, les sèche et collecte la poussière dans un sac de 2,5 litres.
Le robot est annoncé à 999,99 €, avec une remise le portant à 799,99 € jusqu’au 30 novembre.
Enfin, le Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Max est un aspirateur balai à batterie amovible, accompagné d’une station de vidage automatique dotée d’un sac de trois litres.
Xiaomi annonce 280 AW en mode Turbo et jusqu’à 90 minutes d’autonomie, mais ce maximum est mesuré en mode Eco avec le petit accessoire 2-en-1, pas avec la brosse principale pour les sols. Son prix s’établit à 549,99 €.

articles.title: 'Horses are already down the road, I better shut the gate': Nvidia forms national security and export committee, as online commenters wonder why this wasn't already a thing
articles.text:
Nvidia goes into full damage-limitation mode, announcing new 'national security' committee — as Jensen Huang throws in fresh grenade by saying he'd be 'honored' to return as CEO
Where was this when Nvidia's booming profits kicked off during the rise of generative AI?
- Nvidia has announced a new national security and export committee
- This will oversee Nvidia's existing national security and global trade teams
- Harvey Jones, chairman of Nvidia's board, observed that "advanced silicon technologies and the emergence of artificial and superintelligence present unprecedented challenges for national security"
Update, November 17: Since this story was published, former Nvidia boss Jensen Huang released his first statement on X since resigning from the company. He says that "if the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO." You can read the full statement below.
Original story follows...
Nvidia has formed a new 'National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee' in the wake of the resignation of Jensen Huang.
A press release from the board explains that the committee will be "responsible for board-level oversight of the company's national security policies, export control compliance and global trade risk management."
Nvidia already has a National Security Team and a Global Trade Compliance Team, both of which will now report to this committee (as well as reporting to interim CEO Colette Kress), keeping them up to speed on day-to-day operations, we're told.
The committee, chaired by director Suzanne Nora Johnson, will meet at least every quarter, and it'll be advised by "independent third-party experts" in law, national security, and trade compliance.
Harvey Jones, chairman of Nvidia's board, said: "Nvidia recognizes that advanced silicon technologies and the emergence of artificial and superintelligence present unprecedented challenges for national security."
He added that: "We are committed to working constructively with government and industry partners to help establish and advance a robust framework that uses every tool at our disposal to safeguard national security while supporting continued technological innovation."
Analysis: horse, stable door, and so forth
Did someone say damage control? Clearly, Nvidia is a firm that's reeling from the exit of its CEO, and as you've doubtless seen, this has been a controversial matter for a number of reasons.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
While Huang has admitted to having an affair, the allegations around it being with a Chinese spy remain just that – allegations – and there's been no proof of this. So, while this new committee isn't a reaction to this side of the controversy – not as such, as it remains unproven – it is obviously enough a move to shore up any doubt there might be as to Nvidia's stance on national security and global trade therein.
Some of the reaction on Reddit has been predictable, and indeed there's a level of incredulity that Nvidia didn't already have this in place. However, it's worth noting the details here – as the press release states, Nvidia does indeed have teams dedicated to national security and global trade compliance.
Of course, every big tech company has considerable assets in place to guard their intellectual property, and we've also seen Nvidia's export controls in action with the RTX 5090 and China as the most high-profile example (and indeed more broadly in the data center sphere).
What's new with the committee here is that it has oversight across those existing entities, theoretically tightening everything up and bringing in independent experts. Although of course, you could further argue that this should have been in place already on top of the compliance teams. And there are certainly more than a few comments along the same lines as this Redditor's observation: "Horses are already down the road, I better shut the gate..."
Meanwhile, support for the return of Jensen Huang continues to grow, but Nvidia's board is reportedly unmoved – he won't be coming back as CEO, we're told.

articles.title: Dexter, Yellowstone, Twin Peaks… Les meilleures séries à regarder sur Paramount+
articles.text:
Paramount+ : notre top 20 des meilleures séries à voir en streaming en 2026
Vous cherchez les meilleures séries à regarder en ce moment sur le service de streaming Paramount+ ? Les Numériques a sélectionné pour vous la crème de la crème des programmes à voir sur la plateforme.
Lancée en France en 2022, la plateforme Paramount+ a su s'imposer rapidement comme un acteur sérieux du petit monde ô combien concurrentiel du streaming vidéo. S'il n'a pas la popularité de Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ ou HBO Max, Paramount+ peut tout de même compter sur une offre de programmes variés, entre sagas cultes et créations originales de qualité.
Afin de vous aider à trouver le programme qu'il vous faut, Les Numériques vous présente ici sa sélection "maison" des meilleures séries à voir en ce moment sur le service de streaming de Paramount.
Pour rappel, vvous pouvez accéder aux contenus Paramount+ directement sur la plateforme dédiée, mais ceux-ci sont aussi inclus dans le bouquet Ciné Séries de Canal+ ou en option via les chaînes Prime Video.
Quelles sont les meilleures séries de Paramount+ ?
Mobland
Harry Da Souza, un homme de main débrouillard, se voit plongé en plein conflit entre deux familles criminelles, qui cherchent à prendre le pouvoir au risque de renverser des empires et de ruiner des vies.
Si les spectateurs pourront trouver que MobLand manque un poil de substance, les adeptes d’histoires de gangsters seront sans aucun doute conquis par cette fiction, qui n’est pas sans rappeler Gangs of London ou The Gentlemen. Rien d'anodin quand on sait que le réalisateur Guy Ritchie est aux manettes de plusieurs épisodes. MobLand se regarde au final sans déplaisir, et le programme vaut surtout le détour pour l'élégance de sa production, son casting soigné et un Tom Hardy fabuleux et charismatique. Solide.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Opérations Spéciales : Lioness
Inspirée d'un programme militaire américain, cette série suit le quotidien de Joe, officier de pointe de la CIA dans la guerre contre le terrorisme, dans sa quête d'équilibre entre sa vie personnelle et professionnelle. Le programme Lioness supervisé fait appel au jeune Marine Cruz Manuelos, un peu brutale mais passionnée, pour opérer sous couverture aux côtés de Joe et contrecarrer le projet d'un nouveau 11 septembre.
Zoe Saldaña, Nicole Kidman, Dave Annable ou encore Michael Kelly sont au casting de ce thriller explosif signé Taylor Sheridan (Yellowstone). Lioness est une série qui mélange espionnage, opérations militaires et contre-terrorisme dans une intrigue finement ficelée qui tient le spectateur en haleine d'épisode en épisode, avec en son coeur des personnages diablement bien incarnés et surtout très intéressants à découvrir.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Dexter
Brillant expert scientifique du service médico-légal de la police de Miami, Dexter Morgan cache un terrible secret : c'est également un tueur en série ! Mais un tueur pas comme les autres car, grâce au code fourni par son père adoptif, il ne s'en prend qu'à des personnes coupables de meurtres affreux ou de délits répréhensibles.
Cette série aussi palpitante que savoureuse, portée par Michael C. Hall et une galerie d'acteurs captivants, a marqué les années 2000. Ce cocktail des genres - entre policier, drame, comédie et horreur - a connu un succès tel que la franchise n'a de cesse de revenir sur nos écrans d'une manière ou d'une autre. Outre Dexter : New Blood, les fans ont également eu le droit au préquel Dexter : Les Origines, et à la suite Dexter : Resurrection.
- Regardez une bande-annonce de la série :
Entretien avec un vampire
Dans cette nouvelle adaptation de l'oeuvre gothique d'Anne Rice, Jacob Anderson (Game of Thrones) incarne Louis de Pointe du Lac, un vampire qui raconte son histoire d'amour, d'immortalité et de sang au journaliste Daniel Molloy (Eric Bogosian). Il revient ainsi sur sa rencontre avec Lestat de Lioncourt (Sam Reid) et la vie qu'il a mené depuis.
Plus sensuelle et contemporaine que le film avec Tom Cruise et Brad Pitt sorti dans les années 90, cette nouvelle version d'Entretien avec un vampire porte un regard rafraîchissant sur la saga littéraire d'Anne Rice et est soutenue par une distribution épatante. La série a déjà eu droit à deux saisons, et une troisième doit arriver dans le courant de l'année 2026.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Avatar : Le Dernier maître de l'air
Ang est un jeune Maître de l'Air, mais c'est surtout l'Avatar, un être unique qui maîtrise tous les éléments - Feu, Air, Eau et Terre. Lors d'un terrible orage, il sombre dans la mer et hiberne grâce à ses pouvoirs d'Avatar, pour se réveiller un siècle plus tard dans un monde tyrannisé par la puissante Nation du Feu et où il est le dernier représentant de son peuple. Aidé de ses deux amis de la Tribu de l'Eau, Ang va devoir réveiller l'Avatar en lui, apprendre à contrôler tous les éléments et se battre contre la menace que les Maîtres du Feu font peser sur le monde.
Créée par Michael Dante DiMartino et Bryan Konietzko en 2005, Avatar : Le Dernier maître de l'air propose un univers d'une richesse rare dans un programme jeunesse, mêlant de l'action et de l'humour à une intrigue aux dimensions politiques et spirituelles. La série d'animation est surtout dôtée de personnages complexes et attachants, ce qui donne toute sa puissance à cette aventure universelle. Bref, une série culte à voir ou revoir sans modération.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Yellowstone
Dans le Montana, la famille Dutton possède le plus grand ranch des États-Unis près du parc national de Yellowstone. Menée par le patriarche John, la famille se bat contre des politiciens et des promoteurs immobiliers.
Cette série créée par Taylor Sheridan (Comancheria) est devenue en quelques saisons un carton international et une imposante franchise. Du haut de ses cinq saisons, ce western moderne avec en tête d'affiche le magnétique Kevin Costner (Danse avec les loups) a également donné naissance à plusieurs spin-off, 1883 et 1923, également très populaires et d'autres séries dérivées comme Dutton Ranch arrivent bientôt. Vous n'avez donc pas fini de vous régaler.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
The Walking Dead : The Ones Who Live
The Walking Dead : The Ones Who Live
Canal+
- Date de sortie
- 29/03/2024
- Genre
- Fantastique, Horreur/Gore
- Durée
- 60 min
Rick Grimes et Michonne se retrouvent dans un univers post-apocalyptique où les règles de survie sont redéfinies. Séparés par des circonstances extraordinaires, ils doivent naviguer à travers un paysage où les morts-vivants ne sont pas la seule menace. Leur quête les confronte à des dilemmes moraux et des ennemis imprévus, les obligeant à se demander s'ils peuvent encore se faire confiance et s'aimer dans ce monde transformé.
Avec The Walking Dead : The Ones Who Live, la franchise fait brillamment revenir deux de ses personnages phares pour leur faire vivre une nouvelle histoire, aussi épique que bouleversante. Andrew Lincoln et Danai Gurira sont époustouflants et le show s’avère rapidement être parmi ce que l’univers de The Walking Dead a produit de mieux.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Star Trek : Strange New Worlds
Le capitaine Christopher Pike et son équipage à bord de l'USS Enterprise explorent la galaxie à l'époque précédant celle du capitaine Kirk dans ce préquel à la série originale Star Trek des années 1960.
Les séries Star Trek sont nombreuses sur Paramount+, qui compte bien attirer le maximum d'abonnés vers sa plateforme avec cette franchise qui continue encore et toujours de fasciner. Après Star Trek : Discovery et Star Trek : Picard, Strange New Worlds a réussi le pari de redonner du sang neuf à la saga. Et si vous aimez Star Trek et les séries d'animation, n'hésitez pas à découvrir aussi la série Star Trek : Lower Decks, également visible sur le service.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Twin Peaks
Un meurtre a été commis à Twin Peaks, une petite bourgade de l'État de Washington en apparence tranquille. La jeune Laura Palmer est retrouvée morte nue au bord d'un lac, enveloppée dans du plastique. L'agent spécial du FBI, Dale Cooper, envoyé sur place pour démasquer le coupable, mène l'enquête avec le soutien du shérif local, Harry Truman. Ces investigations les amènent à révéler au grand jour les sombres secrets des uns et des autres.
Comment ne pas citer Twin Peaks dans cette liste ? La série de Mark Frost et David Lynch a bouleverser le petit écran en mêlant les genres du policier, du soap, de la comédie et du fantastique avec un ton bien à elle. Résultat : un objet télévisuel unique et étonnant, et une expérience sérielle qui ne vous laissera assurémment pas indifférent.
- Regardez une bande-annonce de la série :
Landman
Dans l'ouest du Texas, les champs pétrolifères peuplent le paysage et régissent l'économie locale et la géopolitique. Tommy Norris est un landman, un employé d'une compagnie pétrolière chargé de régler les problèmes et de dénicher de futurs terrains. Tommy est épuisé par les épreuves de la vie et par son travail. Père de deux enfants, il est divorcé d'Angela. Ce redneck invétéré et cynique n'aime pas obéir aux règles et se laisse rarement dicter sa conduite.
Créée par Taylor Sheridan (Yellowstone), cette série portée par Billy Bob Thornton (Fargo) plonge le spectateur au cœur de l'industrie pétrolière pour suivre non pas ses dirigeants milliardaires, mais ceux qui travaillent pour eux. On découvre alors un monde où il est souvent question de vie ou de mort, où la désillusion est permanente et où il est difficile d'avoir une vie de famille normale. Les personnages sont hauts en couleurs, l'intrigue prenante et on attend avec impatience la suite.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Deadwood
La ruée vers l'or, à l'Ouest des Etats-Unis, mène toute une population à migrer vers des terres plus arides. Parmi eux, beaucoup de criminels et de malfrats en tous genres, prêts à s'installer sur ces nouvelles contrées et y faire commerce... et ainsi profiter des arrivants. Deadwood est une de ces villes nouvelles autour desquelles se greffent les hommes avides d'or, les familles venues de loin, et les rapaces de toutes sortes.
Pépite du petit écran injustement délaissée, Deadwood est une réinterprétation viscérale et brutale du genre western dôtée de la qualité HBO. À la fois crasseuse et hostile, mais portée par une écriture d'une finesse rare, la série de David Milch (NYPD Blue) se distingue par son atmosphère unique, des personnages mémorables, la richesse de ses intrigues et son casting de gueules formidables : Timothy Olyphant, Ian McShane, Robin Weigert, Molly Parker, Brad Dourif...
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Yellowjackets
À la suite d'un accident d'avion, les jeunes membres d'une équipe de football féminin sont contraintes de survivre dans un environnement sauvage et inhospitalier. 30 ans plus tard, on retrouve ce qu'il reste de ses survivantes et découvre comment elles s'en sont sorties.
Yellowjackets rappellera de bons souvenirs aux fans de slashers et d'adolescents massacrés. Mais la série ne s'arrête pas là, et offre une structure narrative avec deux temporalités, l'une en 1996, l'autre en 2021, qui dialoguent et font avancer une histoire mystérieuse de crash d'avion et de cannibalisme. Belle réussite d'horreur, de tension à couper au couteau et de personnages finement écrits, elle vaut aussi le détour pour son casting féminin de qualité : Mélanie Lynskey, Christina Ricci, Juliette Lewis, Ella Purnell, Sophie Thatcher...
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
From
L'histoire d'une ville effrayante au milieu des États-Unis où toute personne qui y entre se retrouve piégée. Les habitants de la ville essaient de maintenir les choses aussi normales que possible tout en cherchant un moyen de s'échapper, car la nuit venue ils sont terrorisés par des monstres meurtriers.
Créée par John Griffin (Le Cratère, La Quatrième Dimension) et produite par des anciens de Lost, cette série d'horreur et de science-fiction captive grâce à une histoire et des personnages fascinants tout en donnant des sueurs froides avec des créatures cauchemardesques. Si ses saisons sont un peu inégales, From vaut tout de même le coup d'œil.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la saison 1 :
Star Trek : Starfleet Academy
Star Trek : Starfleet Academy
Canal+
- Date de sortie
- 15/01/2026
- Genre
- Drame, Science-fiction
- Durée
- 60 min
- Episodes
- 10
À la Starfleet Academy, rien ne leur sera épargné. Sous l’œil sévère de leurs instructeurs, de jeunes cadets se forment au commandement. Entre alliances fragiles, tensions grandissantes et menace tapie dans l’ombre, leur plus grand test ne viendra peut-être pas des salles de classe.
Star Trek: Starfleet Academy possède toutes les cartes en main pour être un succès. Plus orientée vers un public jeune adulte que ses prédécesseurs, la série est un bon point d’entrée pour les spectateurs curieux de découvrir ce monument de la science-fiction, parfois trop intimidant pour les néophytes. Elle accueille justement ses derniers à bras ouverts et met en place une fiction plaisante, certes un tantinet maladroite sur ses débuts, mais très prometteuse par la suite.
- Regardez une bande-annonce de la série :
Tulsa King
Dwight "The General" Manfredi est un ancien parrain de la Mafia italienne à New York tout juste sorti de prison après 25 ans passés à couvrir son boss. Ce dernier l'exile alors à Tulsa, dans l'Oklahoma, où Dwight décide de monter une équipe et établir un nouvel empire.
Sylvester Stallone est la vedette de cette série de gangsters qui mêle habilement humour et action, et invite les spectateurs à rencontrer des personnages bien développés au sein d'une intrigue aux enjeux soigneusement définis. Divertissante à souhait, Tulsa King est une série incontournable de Paramount+.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Dexter : Resurrection
Dexter Morgan sort du coma plusieurs semaines après avoir reçu une balle en pleine poitrine tirée par son fils Harrison qui a depuis fui sans laisser de traces. Résolu à réparer ses erreurs, Dexter décide de partir à sa recherche à New York. Mais le passé de Dexter le rattrape ; Angel Batista de la police de Miami l’a retrouvé et il a des questions. Dexter et son fils appréhendent leur noirceur différemment, mais c’est ensemble qu’ils pourront la contrôler et s’en sortir.
Cette nouvelle mouture de la franchise Dexter est tout à fait divertissante. Michael C. Hall semble s’amuser comme un fou à rejouer les tueurs en série, et on apprécie de le voir reprendre du service dans un nouvel environnement rempli de dangers. Au bout du compte, il faut bien avouer que cette résurrection est un vrai plaisir (coupable).
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Marshals : A Yellowstone Story
Marshals : A Yellowstone Story
Canal+
- Date de sortie
- 01/03/2026
- Genre
- Drame, Western
- Durée
- 60 min
- Episodes
- 13
Après avoir quitté le ranch Yellowstone, Kayce Dutton rejoint une unité d'élite des U.S. Marshals qui fait régner la justice dans le Montana et dans laquelle ses compétences de cow-boy et de Navy SEAL lui seront utiles. Kayce Dutton et ses coéquipiers doivent trouver un équilibre entre le fort coût psychologique que revêt leur poste dans la guerre contre la violence dans la région et leurs obligations familiales.
Marshals : A Yellowstone Story réussit le pari de prolonger l'héritage de la famille Dutton tout en s'essayant à un format plus accessible. Entre la série policière procédurale et le drame contemplatif aux paysages grandioses, ce spin-off offre une transition efficace pour les fans de la première heure. Si elle ne s'affranchit pas totalement de l'ombre de sa série mère, elle constitue un divertissement solide qui permet de retrouver Kayce Dutton dans un nouveau chapitre convaincant.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
The Good Wife
L'épouse d'un homme politique voit sa vie bouleversée par l'incarcération de son mari à la suite d'un scandale sexuel et une affaire de corruption largement relayés par les médias. Dépassant la trahison et l'humiliation publique, Alicia Florrick décide de reprendre sa carrière d'avocate après une pause de 13 ans loin des tribunaux.
Ne ratez pas cette excellente série du duo de producteurs Robert et Michelle King (Your Honor, Evil), portée par la fantastique Julianna Margulies (Urgences) mais aussi Josh Charles, Christine Baranski et Matt Czuchry. En sept saisons, ce drame sur fond de droit et de politique a démontré sa capacité à allier écriture intelligente et personnages brillamment développés.
- Regardez une bande-annonce de la série :
Broadchurch
L’assassinat d'un jeune garçon, Danny Latimer, met sous le feu des projecteurs la communauté de Broadchurch, petite ville côtière du comté de Dorset. L'inspecteur principal Alec Hardy, récemment nommé à son poste, est chargé de l'enquête avec le lieutenant Ellie Miller, proche de la famille Latimer.
Avec son intrigue ciselée et son atmosphère pesante, Broadchurch est un modèle de polar britannique. Portée par le duo formé par David Tennant (Doctor Who, Good Omens) et Olivia Colman (La Favorite, The Crown), la série séduit par la justesse de son écriture et la profondeur de ses personnages. Une référence du genre, aussi prenante qu’émotionnellement marquante.
- Regardez la bande-annonce de la série :
Oz
Oz. Oswald. Pénitencier de haute sécurité. Emerald city. Quartier expérimental de la prison créé par le visionnaire Tim McManus qui souhaite améliorer les conditions de vie des détenus. Mais dans cet univers clos et étouffant se recrée une société terrifiante où dominent la haine, la violence, la peur, la mort. Où tout espoir est vain, où la rédemption est impossible.
Souvent peu citée dans l'histoire de la télévision américaine, Oz est pourtant à l'origine du célèbre modèle HBO qui a donné Les Soprano, Game of Thrones et tous les autres. Une série créée par Tom Fontana (Homicide) brillamment écrite, disséquant la société et les angoisses américaines des années 90 par le prisme du thriller carcéral. Oz vaut aussi et surtout le détour par son casting d'acteurs mémorables : Ernie Hudson, J.K. Simmons, Lee Tergesen, Rita Moreno, BD Wong, Harold Perrineau, Edie Falco... La liste est longue !
- Regardez une bande-annonce de la série :
Les programmes Paramount+ sont disponibles sur le site officiel, mais également via l'offre Ciné Séries de Canal+ et les Prime Video Channels.

articles.title: Meta lança Achados, app para comprar e vender itens no Brasil • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Meta lança Achados, app para comprar e vender itens no Brasil
Aplicativo reúne anúncios do Facebook Marketplace, Grupos e Instagram. Novidade estreia apenas no Android.
A Meta lançou no Brasil, nesta terça-feira (17/11), um novo aplicativo independente para compra e venda de produtos. A plataforma reúne ofertas que circulam pelo Facebook Marketplace e em grupos no Facebook e Instagram.
O aplicativo está disponível para usuários de Android, com 18 anos ou mais que tenham acesso ao Marketplace da Meta, seja entrando com uma conta existente do Facebook ou criando um cadastro pelo próprio Achados.
No Achados, o usuário pode encontrar todos os itens vendidos nos ecommerces da Meta, como roupas, tênis e móveis, incluindo itens anunciados como desapego. Os resultados podem ser filtrados por categoria, preço e distância.
Com o novo app de compra e vendas, a Meta dá mais um sinal de que tenta separar experiências até então integradas às suas redes sociais. Apenas um dia antes do anúncio do Achados, nesta segunda-feira (16/11), a companhia também anunciou o Direct, que leva as DMs do Instagram para um app isolado, funcionando para a rede de fotos e vídeos tal como o Messenger para o Facebook.
O novo aplicativo traz algumas ferramentas para destacar produtos e ajudar na comparação entre ofertas. No topo do feed, por exemplo, a seção Garimpo de hoje reúne uma seleção diária de itens, enquanto outros anúncios aparecem em destaque na busca.
Alguns produtos podem receber o “Selo de achado”, atribuído automaticamente a ofertas que se destacam pelo preço na comparação com anúncios semelhantes encontrados no Facebook Marketplace. O aplicativo também pode mostrar uma faixa de preço estimada em determinados classificados, para que o usuário tenha noção do valor praticado em itens semelhantes antes de negociar.
Quando encontra um produto de interesse, o comprador pode iniciar a conversa pelo próprio Achados ou levar a negociação para o WhatsApp. Da mesma forma, pagamento, entrega ou retirada do item não são intermediados pela plataforma — o usuário e o vendedor ainda precisam combinar os métodos por fora.
Para quem quer vender, o Achados também incorpora a Meta AI ao processo de criação do classificado. A partir de fotos e vídeos do produto, a IA pode analisar o item e sugerir informações para preencher o anúncio.
Entre os campos gerados estão título, descrição, categoria, estado de conservação e preço sugerido, este último calculado com base em anúncios semelhantes. Todas as informações podem ser revisadas e alteradas pelo vendedor.
Um anúncio criado no Achados fica disponível simultaneamente no novo aplicativo e no Facebook Marketplace, sem que o usuário precise cadastrar o mesmo produto novamente.
Assim como no Marketplace do Facebook, o Achados aproveita informações existentes nas outras plataformas da Meta para dar mais contexto sobre o anunciante. Dessa forma, o comprador pode visualizar dados como o ano em que o vendedor entrou no Facebook, histórico de vendas e avaliações recebidas.
Informações do Instagram podem aparecer nesse cartão quando o anunciante optar por vincular e exibir a conta. A Meta afirma que usa sistemas automatizados para identificar e remover possíveis golpes, mas usuários também podem denunciar anúncios e perfis suspeitos pelo aplicativo.

articles.title: 10 desk upgrade gifts to improve PC work and gaming spaces — a monitor riser with charging and USB ports, an excellent speaker upgrade, modern charging hubs, and more
articles.text:
10 desk upgrade gifts to improve PC work and gaming spaces — a monitor riser with charging and USB ports, an excellent speaker upgrade, modern charging hubs, and more
Upgrading a PC right now may be a non-starter, but you can still improve someone's overall desk experience without spending a lot.
It’s a tough time for PC gamers and enthusiasts. Graphics cards are scarce, RAM and storage are prohibitively expensive, and the PC port of GTA VI isn’t expected until sometime in 2027 at the earliest. But core components aside, there are plenty of other ways to improve someone's PC PC-related experience, and upgrading their desk space is a good place to start looking. 
We’ve already covered key peripherals, like keyboards and gaming accessories, so below we’ll be focusing on desk devices that let you connect more devices, stay more organized, improve comfort, or just keep things cleaner. From some of the best desk-friendly PC speakers I’ve tested to tactile media and software controls, and a monitor riser that integrates a USB hub and charging, there’s something here to improve everyone’s desk experience. 
I own most of these devices, or similar previous-gen versions that are no longer available, and can attest to their usefulness. Some live on my desk at the office, while others are better suited for home PC setups, but they all make for a better experience when I'm at my desk.
These unique wrist and elbow rests are designed to hang over the edge of your desk, making them great for those who lean on their elbows, or just for a cramped desk setup. Available in multiple colors and sizes, the 11.8-inch version I have is wide enough that I only need to use one for my compact keyboard at work. So I use the other one at home for my gaming setup.
If your phone has magnetic wireless Qi charging, there's no nicer, more convenient way to charge it than a stand like this, especially when there's additional power and ports for other devices. This Anker model has a built-in retractable cable that can handle up to 60W, so you can charge a non-gaming laptop with this stand at the same time as your phone. I've used a similar charging stand for years, and it helps keep things clean while making charging a second device as simple as grabbing the pull-out cable.
With 11 ports and up to 10 Gbps speed, a solid aluminum shell, and buttons so you can cut power to individual ports, this USB hub is a great addition to a desk without enough ports. It has external power for better stability, and even a 20W USB-C PD port on the end for charging phones or peripherals.
Just plug this simple device into a USB port, and you can control the volume and select tracks without reaching for your keyboard or mouse. It supports recent Windows versions, as well as Mac, without the need for a driver.
The Stream Deck Mini features six configurable buttons for launching software or controlling devices. It's compatible with the full suite of Stream Deck tools from Elgato. There are cheaper alternatives, but the ecosystem (supporting software as well as lights and smart devices) makes these devices more versatile than the competition.
This quirky device combines an under-desk headphone hook and a 20W PD USB charger with one USB-C and two USB-A ports. It brings a bit of extra convenience and tidiness to your desk setup. It comes in four colors and I've been using one under my standing desk since 2023.
These speakers are some of the best desk-friendly options we've tested, with great sound, lots of connection options, and excellent build quality. They're a great audio upgrade to most desk setups, and I have a pair that I bought in 2012 that still look and sound as good as they did when they were new.
We've all dealt with a crumb-covered desk or a dusty PC at some point. This all-in-one desk vacuum and portable air blower can tackle both those issues, and much more. Connect the included accessories to one end for blowing, and the other for suction. It's lived near my desk for years, and my main complaint is that Hoto doesn't ship with a wall mount or a good way to hold its many accessories. I solved that issue with my 3D printer.
This compact 1920 x 720 IPS monitor supports touch input and a 75 Hz refresh. I wouldn't recommend actually playing games on it, but it's a great second screen for game or work chats (or whatever else you want to keep a close eye on while doing other things). Its 24:9 aspect ratio (and a built-in kickstand) make it a good fit under your primary desktop monitor. It also costs less than competing name-brand alternatives.
You can think of this monitor stand as a sort of all-in-one desk upgrade. It packs a USB hub, 15W Qi charging, a 20W PD charging hub, built-in storage drawers, and a metal frame that has space for up to two 32-inch monitors. That's a lot of functionality in one device. I've owned a previous version of this stand since 2020. In fact, it's currently holding the monitor I'm looking at as I type this, and I've found it a good fit for my cramped office desk, since it helps keeps things tidy.
After a rough start with the Mattel Aquarius as a child, Matt built his first PC in the late 1990s and ventured into mild PC modding in the early 2000s. He’s spent the last 15 years covering emerging technology for Smithsonian, Popular Science, and Consumer Reports, while testing components and PCs for Computer Shopper, PCMag and Digital Trends.

articles.title: Razer Unveils the Carbon Fiber Collection
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Razer Unveils the Carbon Fiber Collection
Razer, the leading global lifestyle brand for gamers, today announced the Razer Carbon Fiber Collection, featuring two professional-grade wireless gaming mice: the Razer Viper V4 Pro Carbon Fiber Edition and the Razer DeathAdder V4 Pro Carbon Fiber Edition.
The #1 Mouse Brand takes the two shapes pros trust and reforged the shell in one of the strongest materials available: real woven carbon fiber.Carbon fiber is the hallmark of supercars, aerospace and motorsport, where every milligram counts and every part must perform flawlessly. The Carbon Fiber Collection brings that same excellence to Razer's esports mice, weaving real carbon fiber into the shell while preserving the iconic forms players know.
Charlie Bolton, Razer's Global Head of Design"Design is at the core of how we build at Razer, and the Carbon Fiber Collection is a clear example of that. Working closely with our engineers, we kept the shapes pros trust and rebuilt the shell in real carbon fiber. With no paint to hide behind, every stage had to be exact. The result is a gaming mouse where the material, the shape and the finish all sit at the same level of refinement."
Real Carbon Fiber. Real Engineering.
At the heart of the collection is woven carbon fiber, a material known for its strength-to-weight ratio. Shaping carbon fiber into a mouse shell is anything but simple, and it starts with the weave: the fiber is woven in a 2×2 twill, a pattern that gives carbon fiber its distinctive diagonal look.
Next, the woven sheets are hot-pressed into shape, curing under heat and pressure to hold their form. Computer Numerical Control machinery then cuts each shell to the precise contours of the iconic Viper and DeathAdder shape.
Finally, each shell is left bare under a clear UV-cured coating rather than painted over, so the weave stands out in every light. What players see and hold is real carbon fiber.
From weaving to the final finish, every stage is held to the same exacting standard, reflecting Razer's commitment to crafting top-tier products without compromise.
Light in Hand. Strong Under Pressure.
The result is a lighter shell that is also up to 53% stronger than ABS plastic, built to hold its shape under serious force.
The Viper V4 Pro Carbon Fiber Edition weighs 47 g and the DeathAdder V4 Pro Carbon Fiber Edition weighs 49 g, so every flick and swipe starts faster and stops sharper.
Jaccob "Zellsis" Whiteaker, VALORANT Masters Madrid 2024 Champion"It's the Viper shape I already love, and the carbon fiber makes it feel stronger and more premium".
Nikola "NiKo" Kovač, IEM Cologne Major 2026 Champion"I've used the DeathAdder for a long time, and the carbon fiber version feels a lot more premium and stronger. It's also noticeably lighter".
Crafted. For the Pro.
The Carbon Fiber Collection joins the Razer Viper V4 Pro and Razer DeathAdder V4 Pro lineup from Razer, giving pros the shapes they know in a trusted material that is lighter and stronger.
Both wireless gaming mice are powered by the Razer Focus Pro 50K Optical Sensor Gen-3, Razer HyperSpeed Wireless Gen-2 and Razer Optical Mouse Switches Gen-4, with up to 180 hours of battery life. For the Razer DeathAdder V4 Pro Carbon Fiber Edition, that also means a sensor and battery life upgrade from the base model.

articles.title: Free publie déjà une nouvelle mise à jour de sécurité pour les Freebox, la cinquième en onze jours
articles.text:
Free a déployé lundi une mise à jour du Freebox Server, sa cinquième en onze jours. Cette fois, elle ne porte que sur des correctifs de sécurité.
Une énième mise à jour du Freebox Server est disponible depuis le lundi 16 novembre à 14h30 très exactement, pour les Freebox Revolution, Pop, Delta et Ultra. Elle prolonge une série entamée le 5 novembre, qui a vu l'opérateur de Xavier Niel publier pas moins de cinq versions en onze jours. Comme la plupart des précédentes, elle se limite à des correctifs de sécurité que l’opérateur ne détaille pas.
Désormais cinq mises à jour Freebox en onze jours
Bon, à force, Free risque de nous donner le tournis. Rappelons que le jeudi 5 novembre, l'opérateur lançait la version 4.13.3 du logiciel qui équipe ses Freebox, avant d'enchaîner avec les 4.13.4 et 4.13.5, cette dernière à minuit pile d'ailleurs, soit trois versions en 38 heures à peine. La 4.13.6 a suivi dans la nuit du 10 au 11 novembre, et voici donc la 4.13.7. Toutes, comme la 4.13.2 du 22 octobre, renforcent la sécurité.
Seule la 4.13.6 sortait du lot, avec deux bugs nommés noir sur blanc et corrigés. Selon les abonnés, les enregistrements de chaînes comme TF1 et M6 sur le disque de la box échouaient depuis la 4.13.3, et la console des machines virtuelles ne répondait plus depuis la 4.13.5. La 4.13.7, elle, revient au service minimum, avec pour seule explication donc, le déploiement de « correctifs de sécurité ».
Comment installer la mise à jour 4.13.7 sur votre Freebox
Free cultive donc le mystère. Son application mobile éponyme parle toujours d'un « renforcement de la sécurité et de la protection du système », sans nommer la moindre faille. Une discrétion courante en matière de sécurité, puisqu'on le sait, détailler une faille tant que des box tournent encore sur l'ancienne version reviendrait à renseigner d'éventuels individus malveillants.
Quoi qu'il en soit, pour installer la version 4.13.7, il faut, choix numéro un, redémarrer le Freebox Server en naviguant, sur le boîtier, avec les touches directionnelles qui mènent au menu « Redémarrage », qu'il suffit de valider.
La solution la plus simple, c'est peut-être de passer par l'application Free. Dans la partie consacrée aux équipements Freebox, choisissez « Serveur internet », puis « Version logicielle » et « Mettre à jour », ou lancez directement « Redémarrer ». Pour vérifier que la 4.13.7 est bien en place, l'écran du boîtier affiche la version via « Informations avancées » puis « Version » sur Pop et Ultra, « Système » puis « Version » sur Freebox Revolution, et directement « Version » sur Delta.

articles.title: “Me parece genial que la gente experimente en casa”: Sam Altman defiende la compra de memoria RAM para PC
articles.text:
El CEO de OpenAI, Sam Altman, defendió la compra de memoria RAM para computadoras personales y sostuvo que las personas deberían poder adquirir grandes cantidades para experimentar en sus hogares, pese a que la escasez mundial y el avance de la inteligencia artificial (IA) elevaron los precios de estos componentes.
“Quiero ser claro: quiero que la gente tenga mucha RAM; creo que todos deberían poder comprar mucha RAM para su ordenador”, declaró durante la cumbre Silicon Valley & The World. “Me parece genial que la gente experimente en casa”.
Altman había generado controversia el mes pasado al afirmar, durante el podcast Cheeky Pint, que era “terrible” que todos tuvieran memoria RAM en sus computadoras en vez de concentrarla en centros de datos.
De dónde viene la escasez de memoria RAM a nivel global
Las empresas dedicadas a la inteligencia artificial han concentrado el suministro global de memoria para sus centros de datos, una dinámica que impulsó aumentos de precios en productos como teléfonos y consolas de videojuegos.
OpenAI, según explicó Altman, se ha visto limitada en distintos momentos por la memoria, el ensamblaje de racks, la capacidad de los centros de datos o algún componente imprevisto.
El déficit solo podría corregirse si la industria elevara su producción anual un 12% en 2026 y 2027, según Counterpoint Research. Los planes vigentes, sin embargo, permiten prever una expansión de apenas 7,5%, por debajo del ritmo necesario para equilibrar la oferta y la demanda.
La falta de abastecimiento podría agravarse: los principales fabricantes apenas estarían en condiciones de cubrir el 60% de la demanda global hacia finales de 2027, según estimaciones de Nikkei Asia. La insuficiencia se extendería durante varios años por el auge de la IA y el cambio de prioridades en la producción de chips.
De qué forma están enfocando los recursos los principales fabricantes de memoria
La raíz del problema está en la reorientación de la capacidad industrial. Samsung, SK Hynix y Micron, compañías que concentran cerca del 90% del mercado mundial, priorizan las memorias de alto rendimiento destinadas a centros de datos e inteligencia artificial, mientras la RAM convencional para dispositivos de consumo queda relegada.
Las nuevas plantas de fabricación tampoco podrán responder de inmediato a la escasez, porque tardarán años en alcanzar su funcionamiento pleno. Las inversiones actuales, por lo tanto, no se traducirán en una mejora rápida del suministro disponible para computadoras, teléfonos y consolas.
Ante este contexto, Altman reconoció que los precios de la DRAM, un tipo de memoria dinámica de acceso aleatorio, se dispararon en los últimos meses. “El mundo no se desarrolló tanto, y ahora hemos visto cómo los precios—no sé con exactitud, pero tal vez se multiplicaron por cinco o siete, algo así— se han disparado”, señaló.
El ejecutivo sostuvo que habría sido preferible construir una cadena de suministro de memoria “mucho más extensa”. Agregó que, ante un suministro limitado, compartir la capacidad disponible podría permitir que funcionara por completo en lugar de fallar ocasionalmente en los dispositivos de los usuarios.
A qué dispositivos afecta la crisis global de memoria RAM
La crisis ya impacta sobre los usuarios finales. Microsoft y Sony comunicaron aumentos en productos como las Surface y la PlayStation 5, mientras que Valve advirtió sobre posibles faltantes de la consola portátil Steam Deck en distintas regiones por la carencia de RAM.
Asimismo, el director ejecutivo de Dell, Michael Dell, anticipó que “todavía estamos en las primeras etapas” de la crisis y que no se avizora una pronta solución.
Queda esperar cómo avanza esta crisis a nivel global y si los fabricantes enfocaran sus productos a dispositivos de servicio y no solo a la infraestructura que soporta el avance de la IA.

articles.title: Everspin Looks to Broaden MRAM Adoption with LPDDR Standard - EE Times
articles.text:
Giving magnetoresistive RAM (MRAM) access to the low power DDR (LPDDR) ecosystem requires more than adapting a memory interface; it needs controller developers to have confidence there is enough customer demand to put support into silicon.
Everspin Technologies sees the development of a standard as the pathway forward. That is why Steffen Hellmold, the company’s VP of corporate strategy, is chairing a new JEDEC task group under JEDEC’s JC-42.6 Low Power Memories Subcommittee to explore an LPDDR persistent memory (PMEM) standard, he told EE Times in an interview. “If you want to have something to happen, then you need to be willing to contribute.”
Everspin’s motivation is practical because its experience adapting DDR controllers for MRAM does not translate readily to the newer LPDDR implementations it wants to target, Hellmold said.
The company’s DDR4 MRAM has been implemented in systems such as IBM’s FlashCore Module by tweaking DRAM host controllers to handle smaller page sizes and slightly different timings. Hellmold said that was workable because the controllers were soft IP. In AMD Xilinx FPGAs, for example, the memory interface generator could adapt DDR4 soft IP for MRAM.
Looking toward LPDDR5 and LPDDR6, Hellmold said the available controller implementations instead rely on hard IP, shifting those changes upstream to controller suppliers. “Hard IP means that you need to convince a host controller manufacturer to modify their host controller to also support MRAM,” he said.
IP vendors will only make that investment if there is a standard and enough customer demand, Hellmold said, but the payoff is the size of the LPDDR controller ecosystem. “If we can leverage that and slightly adapt those host controller IP blocks to work with MRAM, then we have a ubiquitous on-ramp for MRAM to easily dovetail into a much larger number of systems and applications.”
Details of the JEDEC work are confidential, Hellmold said, but he outlined three types of changes that will need to be made to achieve a standard. The proposed work involves additions, substitutions, and reductions rather than reproducing every capability of an LPDDR DRAM interface. He said MRAM does not require refresh or support for DRAM’s highest speed bins, but it does need accommodation for page sizes measured in tens or hundreds of bytes rather than kilobytes, along with somewhat longer timings.
Hellmold said these accommodations must be configurable, and that the flexibility previously available through soft IP needs to become part of what controller implementations expose to software.
For now, the JEDEC task group is an exploratory initiative, not an approved specification, aimed at leveraging existing LPDDR infrastructure while limiting changes to DRAM standards and host controllers.
Hellmold said participants in the group span edge AI, IoT, industrial, automotive, enterprise storage, and hyperscale data centers, including prospective users as well as suppliers. Even with a standard, controller IP vendors must still adopt it and get it into silicon, so he’d like to see as many potential users as possible come forward with their requirements.
There are several applications that could benefit should a standard come to fruition, Hellmold said. Everspin customers are asking for gigabyte-scale solutions, and higher-density MRAM coupled with an LPDDR persistent-memory interface would address that requirement.
Hellmold said MRAM’s trajectory puts a more cost-effective alternative to battery-backed DRAM within reach, while using MRAM as a persistent write cache ahead of NAND for checkpointing could reduce the time processors wait while preserving state. “There are tangible opportunities within line of sight,” he said.
This JEDEC initiative aligns with other efforts to broaden MRAM’s reach. Everspin recently demonstrated a 4-GB pool of CXL-attached DDR4 MRAM at the SNIA Developer Conference, which Hellmold presented as a persistent cache tier between DRAM and NAND rather than a replacement for NAND.
MRAM in the data center isn’t new either, but NOR flash shortages and AI workloads are helping to broaden its use in servers, data centers, and satellites.

articles.title: Nvidia claims Vera CPU can gain up to 39% performance boost via software optimization at SC26 — architectural fine-tuning for Arm cores needed to take full advantage of chip
articles.text:
Nvidia claims its Vera CPU can gain up to 39% performance boost via software optimization at SC26 — architectural fine-tuning is needed to fully unleash custom Olympus cores
Vera can speed up old code out of the box, but there's more performance to unlock
Nvidia's Vera CPU, designed as both a standalone data-center part and a host for Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 servers, offers impressive performance thanks to substantially higher execution resources per core than its predecessor, Grace. However, Nvidia admits at Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) that existing software cannot always take full advantage of Vera's resources without adaptation for the architecture.
The company shared that architecture-specific software optimizations can boost Vera's performance by nearly 39% in certain computationally intensive workloads. But despite offering unbeatable single-thread performance, the CPU is not positioned for general-purpose workloads.
Get the full Tom's Hardware experience on your device with our brand-new app. Bookmark articles, use our smart search feature, personalize your feed, and get push notifications so you never miss a beat.
Unlike Grace, which relies on off-the-shelf Neoverse V2 CPU cores developed by Arm, Vera uses Nvidia's proprietary Olympus cores specifically designed to maximize per-core performance as well as to ensure high aggregate throughput. To that end, Nvidia equipped Olympus with a wide front end that features a 10-wide decoder, a neural branch predictor, a deep out-of-order execution engine, six vector execution units, four load pipelines, two store pipelines, all backed with large private caches and advanced prefetch mechanisms.
In fact, Nvidia deliberately opted for 88 high-performance general-purpose cores with support for its proprietary spatial multithreading technology (176 threads in total) rather than maximizing the number of cores per socket, as the maximum possible single-thread performance was one of the key design goals for Vera.
"CPU design is really just a game of trade-offs," said Hannah Coutand, who leads Vera CPU marketing at Nvidia, in an interview with Tom's Hardware Premium. "You could maximize for a lot of cores, but literally when you maximize the die for lots of cores, you do not actually have space to maximize for IPC, like instructions per clock."
Although Nvidia primarily positions Vera as a CPU for agentic AI and other AI-related workloads, the company originally conceived its Olympus microarchitecture with data processing applications in mind. As it turned out, the key attributes of Vera — high per-core performance, high memory bandwidth, and low memory access latency — are precisely what agentic AI workloads need as well, according to Coutand.
"We are very clear in our strategy with Vera and our positioning with Vera that it is not a general-purpose CPU," Coutand said. " If you want a web server for your cloud data center, there are probably other choices that are better suited for that than Vera. [Vera is made for] workloads […] that require that high per-core speed, high memory bandwidth, low latency. […] It has great fungibility for lots of workloads as long as those workloads value the things that Vera is good for."
Software optimizations make good things better
To assess the computational capabilities of Nvidia's custom Olympus microarchitecture and its advantages over Neoverse V2, Nvidia's researchers used a double-precision general matrix multiplication (DGEMM) workload based on an assembly kernel from OpenBLAS, an open-source linear algebra library. While OpenBLAS features a kernel tailored for the Arm Neoverse V2 cores that power Nvidia's Grace processor, it lacks one specifically designed for Olympus.
To examine the efficiency of the two microarchitectures, the researchers used a standalone benchmark called miniKernelGEMM with a 128 × 128 matrix multiplication problem that fits into the L1 cache of both processors.
The Grace CPU achieved 4.51 instructions per clock (IPC) and 13.03 FP64 operations per cycle with the Neoverse V2 kernel, whereas Vera executed 5.43 instructions per clock and 15.69 FP64 operations per cycle with the very same code, an improvement of approximately 20%.
However, when the researchers used a kernel specifically optimized for Olympus, Vera’s performance increased to 7.53 instructions per clock and 21.75 FP64 operations per cycle. As a result, Vera outperformed its predecessor by nearly 67% on a per-core, per-clock basis in this particular workload.
Grace's Neoverse V2 microarchitecture has four 128-bit SIMD pipelines that can perform a total of 16 FP64 operations per clock, whereas Nvidia's Olympus has six such pipelines that can execute up to 24 FP64 operations per cycle, a 50% improvement.
But where the Neoverse V2-optimized kernel uses 81.4% of Grace's peak FP64 throughput, it uses only about 66.5% of Vera's computational capabilities. With changes to matrix tile organization, register allocation, and instruction scheduling that better suit the Olympus microarchitecture, the researchers managed to utilize 90.6% of its peak FP64 throughput, according to Nvidia's tutorial published at SC26.
While software developed and optimized for existing Arm-based data center processors can still benefit from the capabilities of Nvidia's Olympus cores without any specific optimizations, the company's SC26 benchmark results demonstrate that at least some applications will need to be fine-tuned for the new microarchitecture to take full advantage of its execution resources. Of course, it remains to be seen how much performance can be gained through Olympus-specific optimizations in workloads other than matrix multiplication.
As Nvidia expands beyond CPUs that primarily serve as companions to its data center GPUs and chases the standalone server CPU market, the company will have to ensure that performance-critical software takes advantage of the architectural peculiarities of its processors, much like Intel and AMD have done for decades.
But the company is already deeply experienced with partner and ecosystem development for platforms like CUDA, so as Vera is more widely adopted, that experience could prove useful in spurring optimizations for these CPUs going forward.
Anton Shilov is a contributing writer at Tom’s Hardware. Over the past couple of decades, he has covered everything from CPUs and GPUs to supercomputers and from modern process technologies and latest fab tools to high-tech industry trends.

articles.title: Como bloquear no TikTok: passo a passo do app ou PC • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Como bloquear no TikTok: passo a passo do app ou PC
Ao bloquear alguém no TikTok, a pessoa não poderá encontrar seu perfil nas buscas, enviar mensagens ou interagir com suas publicações
Você pode usar o aplicativo do celular Android e iPhone ou a versão web para bloquear pessoas no TikTok. Independentemente da plataforma, basta acessar o perfil do usuário para encontrar a opção para afastar interações indesejadas na rede social.
Após bloquear no TikTok, a plataforma corta o contato discretamente, impedindo que a outra pessoa encontre seu perfil, veja seus vídeos, envie mensagens ou interaja com seus vídeos.
A seguir, o Tecnoblog te mostra três formas de bloquear uma conta no TikTok.
Você pode bloquear alguém no TikTok e evitar interações indesejadas por meio do aplicativo para celular Android ou iPhone. Para isso, siga o passo a passo abaixo:
O meio mais rápido de bloquear pessoas no TikTok é utilizando a ferramenta dos comentários dos vídeos da plataforma, permitindo restringir até 100 usuários simultaneamente. Para isso, siga o seguinte caminho:
Abra o aplicativo do TikTok no celular Android ou iPhone e toque em “Perfil”, no canto inferior direito. Em seguida, escolha e abra qualquer vídeo publicado na sua conta.
Toque no ícone de balão com três pontos, localizado na barra no canto direito da tela, para acessar os comentários do seu vídeo.
Toque no botão de configurações de comentários, na parte superior da janela, e selecione a opção “Ger. Comentários” para ativar a seleção múltipla.
Toque nas caixas de seleção ao lado dos comentários publicados pelas contas indesejadas que você deseja bloquear no TikTok.
Toque em “Mais”, na parte inferior direita da tela, e escolha “Bloquear contas”. Por fim, confirme a ação na janela pop-up que surgirá na tela.
Abra o navegador do seu PC, acesse tiktok.com e faça login na sua conta. Clique na barra “Pesquisar”, localizada no topo da tela, e digite o nome de usuário da pessoa que você quer bloquear no TikTok.
No resultado da busca, clique em cima do perfil que será bloqueado para avançar.
Clique no botão de três pontos, ao lado do botão de compartilhar, e selecione “Bloquear”. Na janela pop-up, confirme a ação clicando novamente em “Bloquear”
Ao bloquear pessoas no TikTok, a plataforma corta o contato entre as contas discretamente. Confira as principais mudanças que acontecem na prática:
Ao bloquear alguém no TikTok, a plataforma não envia nenhum alerta ou notificação avisando a outra pessoa sobre a restrição. Contudo, ela pode descobrir indiretamente ao notar que seu perfil sumiu das buscas e que não consegue mais enviar DMs ou interagir com seus vídeos.
Vale dizer que esses sinais também podem ser confundidos com a exclusão da conta, mas você ainda pode aparecer em grupos compartilhados, Lives ou Duets com terceiros.
Ao bloquear no TikTok, as DMs antigas não são excluídas automaticamente e continuam visíveis na sua caixa de entrada. No entanto, o envio de novos textos fica bloqueado para ambos e os links de vídeos compartilhados anteriormente na conversa param de funcionar.
Caso você decida desbloquear a pessoa no TikTok, o histórico do bate-papo continua intacto e a troca de mensagens pode ser retomada normalmente. Ainda assim, será preciso seguir o usuário novamente para restabelecer o contato.
Existem alguns sinais claros que ajudam a descobrir se alguém decidiu bloquear seu perfil no TikTok. Veja os principais indícios para chegar:
Bloquear no TikTok significa cortar totalmente o contato, ocultando seu perfil e vídeos para outra pessoa e impedindo que ela siga, envie mensagens ou use recursos como o Duet e Stitch. Essa ação remove o conteúdo dela da sua tela e é indicada para afastar contatos indesejados ou casos de assédio.
Silenciar no TikTok é o ato que permite ocultar apenas os vídeos ou notificações de um usuário no seu feed, sem deixar de segui-lo ou romper o vínculo. O perfil silenciado continua vendo seus vídeos públicos e interagindo normalmente, sendo a opção ideal para reduzir a exposição sem criar atritos.
